packageRules.description: Left ungrouped so a Go stdlib security patch merges as its own PR, independent of regular dependency bumps. Keeps the default 7-day minimumReleaseAge: GitHub's setup-go version manifest lags behind go.dev, and a brand-new patch can be unresolvable in CI until the manifest catches up. separateMinorPatch keeps a same-line patch bump (routine, low-risk) from being collapsed into a Go feature-release bump (1.26.x -> 1.27.0, needs deliberate review) into one PR.
